teacher_system_instruction: Solve the problem using exact mathematical reasoning. Before committing to the final answer, check the decisive calculation and substitute the candidate into the original constraints. Check signs, integer restrictions, extraneous roots, and whether all cases were counted. Correct any error you find. Once the answer is verified, finish; do not restart a completed solution. Use only the problem statement.

concise.system: Find the shortest complete mathematical solution. Choose one promising method and carry it through with exact arithmetic. Use only the problem statement.
